mapper.select:
SELECT tmp.areaName, tmp.yjl, tmp.number, CONCAT(CAST(IF(ROUND(tmp.number / tmp.yjl * 100, 2) IS NULL, 0, ROUND(tmp.number / tmp.yjl * 100, 2)) AS CHAR),'%') AS zb
, IF(ROUND(tmp.xynf / 10000, 2) IS NULL, 0, ROUND(tmp.xynf / 10000, 2)) AS xynf
, IF(ROUND(tmp.yjnsr / 10000, 2) IS NULL, 0, ROUND(tmp.yjnsr / 10000, 2)) AS yjnsr
, tmp.areaId
FROM ( SELECT
CASE WHEN area.type_ = '一级' THEN '省本级' ELSE area.name_ END AS areaName CASE WHEN us.name_ch IS NULL THEN '其他' ELSE us.name_ch END AS areaName CASE WHEN county.type_ = '二级' THEN CONCAT(county.name_,'市本级') ELSE county.name_ END AS areaName
, COUNT(1) AS yjl
, COUNT(IF(a.exte_flag = 1, TRUE, NULL)) AS number, SUM(a.NEW_SCHEME_FEE) AS xynf
, COUNT(IF(a.NEW_RED_CREATE_DATE != '', TRUE, NULL)) AS number
, COUNT(IF(a.NEW_CONSUME_TIME IS NOT NULL, TRUE, NULL)) AS number, SUM(a.NEW_AMOUNT_PER_YEAR) AS yjnsr
, a.area_id AS areaId , a.county_id AS areaId
FROM (
) a LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON a.user_id = us.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON a.area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area county ON a.county_id = county.id_ WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.status = #{isDistribute} AND a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{leftTime},'%Y-%m-%d') AND a.create_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{rightTime},'%Y-%m-%d'),INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND a.business_dep = #{businessDep} AND a.is_imp_prt = #{isImpPrt} AND a.grp_type = #{grpType}
GROUP BY a.area_id ORDER BY area.order_ IS NULL, area.order_ ASC AND a.area_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.county_id ORDER BY a.county_id ASC, area.order_ ASC AND a.area_id IN #{id} AND a.county_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id DESC
LIMIT #{startRow}, #{pageSize}
) tmp

ttt.user_id FROM ( SELECT 0 AS rank, CONCAT(CAST(IF(ROUND(tt.xyCount * 1.0 / tt.warnCount * 100, 2) IS NULL, 0, ROUND(tt.xyCount * 1.0 / tt.warnCount * 100, 2)) AS CHAR),'%') AS xyRate, tt.* FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.type_ = '一级' THEN '省本级' WHEN a.type_ = '二级' THEN a.name_ WHEN a.type_ = '三级' THEN p.name_ ELSE '' END AS areaName, CASE WHEN a.type_ = '一级' THEN '' WHEN a.type_ = '二级' THEN '市本级' WHEN a.type_ = '三级' THEN a.name_ ELSE '' END AS countryName, u.name_ch AS managerName, u.name_ AS relationTel, COUNT(1) AS warnCount, COUNT(IF(mm.status_ = 'end' AND mm.end_reason IN ('0','1'), TRUE, NULL)) AS normalClose, COUNT(IF(mm.status_ = 'end' AND mm.end_reason IN ('2','3'), TRUE, NULL)) AS abnormalClose, COUNT(IF(mm.status_ = 'tracking', TRUE, NULL)) AS tracking, COUNT(IF(mm.status_ NOT IN ('end','tracking') OR mm.status_ IS NULL, TRUE, NULL)) AS untreated, COUNT(IF(mm.exte_flag = 1, TRUE, NULL)) AS xyCount, ROUND(SUM(mm.NEW_SCHEME_FEE) / 10000, 2) AS xyFee, mm.user_id FROM ( SELECT m.id_, m.user_id, t.status_, t.end_reason, w.exte_flag, w.NEW_SCHEME_FEE, w.id FROM maintenance_detail m LEFT JOIN topp_order t ON m.order_id = t.id_ LEFT JOIN wide_sys_auto_warning w ON m.detail_id = w.id WHERE m.STATUS = 1 AND m.order_type = 'Wide' AND m.order_category = 'U' AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{leftTime} AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{rightTime} UNION SELECT m.id_, m.user_id, t.status_, t.end_reason, w.exte_flag, w.NEW_SCHEME_FEE, w.id FROM maintenance_detail m LEFT JOIN topp_order t ON m.order_id = t.id_ LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning c ON m.detail_id = c.id_ LEFT JOIN wide_sys_auto_warning w ON c.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = w.main_order_flow_no WHERE m.STATUS = 1 AND m.order_type = 'Wide' AND m.order_category = 'C' AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{leftTime} AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{rightTime} ) mm LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mm.user_id = u.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON u.org_id = o.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON a.id_ = o.area_id LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.parent_ = p.id_ WHERE 1=1
AND (a.id_ IN #{id} OR p.id_ IN #{id})
AND p.id_ IN #{id} AND a.id_ IN #{id}
AND u.name_ch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{managerName}, '%') AND u.name_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phoneId}, '%') AND m.is_imp_prt = #{isImpPrt} AND m.grp_type = #{grpType} GROUP BY mm.user_id ) tt ) ttt ORDER BY ttt.xyRate DESC
